subject: no value for log2fold change or P value

messages.author: 63450654949b6f53
messages.subject: no value for log2fold change or P value
parts:
Hi, 

The report I generated with MSstats returned a significant amount of lines with NA for Log2Fold Change and NA for P value. These proteins are found in a couple of bioreplicates and both conditions. However, not all bioreplicates (1-6) and not consistent conditions A and P) for each (eg . Protein A0A0B5KBC7 was found in sample 1A, 5A, 3P and 4P but no others).
Is there any explanation for these non values?

messages.author: 13904eb0f06097b0
messages.subject: Re: no value for log2fold change or P value
parts:
Hello,

For this example, while this protein was measured in multiple conditions, only one replicate in each condition was measured. The variance of a protein can only be measured if we have at least two replicates in a single condition. Thus we cannot do any statistical testing on this protein because we cannot measure the variance.

Hope this helps!

Devon

Thank you for your help. 

Is it that the conditions are being treated as pairs, rather than individually. So there needs to be a 1A and a corresponding 1P to test the variance. Rather than the protein being present in any replicate of a single condition? 
IE statistical testing can be performed on a protein if it shows up in the following: 
1A, 1P
But not if it's: 
1A, 2P
